failures.name: CROSS_SPLIT_SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE_NOT_REJECTED
failures.observation: A dev case and a heldout case with identical semantic-core content but different case_id/title/tags were accepted by policy construction and policy-content validation.
failures.root_cause: Semantic-core fingerprints are used to block benchmark-to-ordinary reclassification but are not enforced as a uniqueness/isolation constraint across benchmark splits.
failures.capability_gap: The benchmark factory must prevent evaluation-equivalent content from existing in train-eligible and evaluation-only partitions under different identities.

failures.name: PARAPHRASED_HELDOUT_DERIVED_ORDINARY_LAUNDERING
failures.observation: A lightly paraphrased copy explicitly derived from a heldout benchmark case was accepted as an ordinary training source because its exact semantic-core digest changed.
failures.root_cause: The current lineage guard is an exact structured hash, not a semantic near-duplicate detector, so benign wording changes destroy equality while retaining benchmark content lineage.
failures.capability_gap: Detect transformed/near-duplicate benchmark lineage across paraphrase and presentation changes without exposing hidden fresh cases to the repair implementer.

failures.name: PARTIAL_HELDOUT_FRAGMENT_REUSE_NOT_DETECTED
failures.observation: An ordinary source that changed wrapper context but reused evaluation-critical heldout fragments was accepted by both policy construction and validation.
failures.root_cause: Whole-record semantic-core equality cannot detect field-level or span-level contamination when only part of an evaluation case is reused.
failures.capability_gap: Detect partial benchmark contamination at field/span level and surface the matched reference evidence for review.

failures.name: NFKC_COMPATIBILITY_CASE_ID_COLLISION
failures.observation: A benchmark identifier and an ordinary-source identifier that differ under NFC but collapse to the same value under NFKC were accepted as separate identities.
failures.root_cause: The system identifier contract requires NFC only and does not constrain compatibility-equivalent Unicode forms or a safer identifier alphabet.
failures.capability_gap: Use a compatibility-safe canonical identity representation for system keys before namespace uniqueness checks.
